title: Spacious Modern Loft, walk to Broadway,Gulch&more!
description:
Beautiful, fresh and modern apartment blocks from Broadway. This apartment is in a gorgeous building with top-notch amenities! You're going to love your stay here and feeling like you're truly living the dream on your vacation.

Whether you're here for weekend with friends, a family vacation or romantic getaway, you're going to be so glad you chose to stay with us in the loft.

Awaiting for you is lush decor, the modern touches and feel like you are on the fabulous vacation that you are!

The space
This is a beautiful apartment with a very spacious layout. Enjoy a massive leather couch, a full kitchen, 2 bedrooms with luxurious memory foam queen beds in each and an amazing view of downtown Nashville and the Gulch. 

You'll sleep well and have an amazing retreat to come back to after hitting the town!

Guest access
I'll be with you through the whole process. You will receive a code to get into the lobby and you'll receive a code sent to your phone which will give you access to a set of key fobs. These will be used to get into your room and access all of the amazing amenities in the building.
